newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends firm in third straight closing high.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends firm in third straight closing high.

text.p: The FTSE 100 ended a featureless abbreviated session on a firmer note, scoring its third consecutive closing high, and though activity was muted on Christmas eve, dealers said the market was setting itself for a January rally.
The leading blue chip index settled up 5.2 points at 4,092.4, just 7.6 points from the record intra-day high reached last Friday.
"You couldn't tell from today because there was no interest at all, but I think the market still has a good tone to it," said one dealer.
